notes.title: 手滑误删翻译文件心态爆炸，遂延迟更新 | ENG ver. update is delayed since I lost translatation files
notes.notes:
今天早上，想着整理一下文件。

然后大抵是没睡醒，全选，然后Shift+Delete，覆盖上新文件。

打开英文用工程一看，我本地化文件呢？

然后捣鼓了半天数据恢复，未果。

[b]寄！[/b]

所以本次更新（V1.0）暂缓，正在加班加点重译。

————————————————————————

This morning, I thought about organising some files.

Then I selected all folders, press Shift+Delete and overwrote with new folders.

Then I opened the English project file.

F***, where are my localization files?

Then tried to recover my data for half day, unsuccessful.

[b]GG! [/b]

So update (V1.0) will be later, since I'm translating again RIGHT NOW.

notes.title: Something about the Game's Release | 有关游戏发售的一些情况
notes.notes:
Thanks for your attention!

[i]Obscure Chronicle of Dynasty[/i] will be released on 21 July 2023 at 16:00.

The game will remain 'Early Access' (EA) with a release version number of 0.92. There will be at least 8 iterations between the 'Early Access' version and the formal version.

The game is priced at RMB9.69, USD1.99, and will be priced below Steam's recommended price in all East Asian regions. A 40% discount will be applied to the first release.
---------------------------------------------
感谢各位的关注！

《后汉稽异录》将于2023年7月21日16:00发布。（由于Steam无法更改发售日期的显示方式，抑或是我根本没研究明白更改发售日期的方式，总之Steam商店页的发售日期似乎无法更改为具体日期。）

发布时，《后汉稽异录》将保持「抢先体验」（EA）状态，发售版本号为0.92。在「抢先体验」版与正式版之间，将至少有8个版本的迭代。

游戏定价为RMB9.69，USD1.99，东亚区都将保持低于Steam推荐价格之状态。首发折扣为40%。
